# SegurIA Security Suite

> Security Suite para seguridad física y operación: centro de control, infraestructura, incidentes, evidencia, Vision, Edge, cámaras, sensores, gateways y automatización. Powered by N3uralia.

Canonical website: https://seguria.tech
Technology provider: https://www.n3uralia.com
Primary language: es-CL
Market: Chile
Product category: Security Suite

## What SegurIA is

SegurIA is a Security Suite that integrates physical security, security operations, infrastructure, cameras, sensors, local gateways, incidents, private evidence, intelligent visual analysis, edge processing and operational automation into one coordinated product experience.

SegurIA should not be described as only a camera platform, CCTV dashboard, AI vision tool or isolated monitoring product. Those capabilities are surfaces of the same Security Suite.

## Technology relationship

SegurIA is powered by N3uralia.

N3uralia provides the reusable technology engines for intelligence, automation, analysis, orchestration and differential system logic. SegurIA specializes those capabilities for security and operational workflows.

N3uralia: https://www.n3uralia.com

## Security Suite surfaces

1. Control Center — consolidated operational state, priorities, devices, cameras and active cases.
2. Infrastructure — properties, cameras, sensors, gateways, inventory, heartbeat and device state.
3. Incidents — alerts, severity, acknowledgement, resolution, dismissal and audit trail.
4. Evidence — authenticated snapshots, private storage, protected media access and traceability.
5. Vision — operation-scoped visual analysis, quality diagnostics, human review and derived alerts.
6. Edge — local RTSP processing, motion/change gating, frame selection, deduplication, offline spool and retry.

## Additional platform capabilities

- Multi-company portal and scoped authorization
- Organizations, properties, operations and roles
- Supabase Auth and Row Level Security
- Local gateway identities
- Device inventory and state synchronization
- Gateway heartbeat and event ingestion
- Authenticated camera snapshots
- Protected video sessions when applicable
- Operational audit trail
- Automation over normalized events
- Local-first degraded/offline operation
- Explicit separation between canonical operational truth and AI-derived outputs

## Architecture principles

- Local-first, cloud-coordinated
- Deny by default for protected resources
- Operation-level ownership for Vision resources
- Private evidence storage
- Idempotent camera and inference identities per operation
- Human review remains part of AI-assisted workflows
- AI output is derived information and does not silently overwrite canonical operational truth

## Source-of-truth guidance

Public product claims should be grounded in published SegurIA pages, repository evidence and canonical application data. AI-generated analysis is derived information and should not be treated as canonical operational truth unless explicitly validated by the product workflow.
